identity.shortDescription: Advanced dental care in a comfortable, relaxing and friendly environment.
identity.longDescription: At Lumière Dental Clinic we combine advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment. Every treatment plan is built around one person: you.
identity.registration: Karnataka Dental Council Reg. No. KDC/2009/4471
identity.$logo: Optional. Leave src blank to use the built-in wordmark, which draws the name above from identity.name / identity.suffix.

hero.subtitle: Advanced dental care in a comfortable, relaxing & friendly environment.

image.alt: Modern dental treatment room with natural light

badge.text: SCROLL TO EXPLORE • SCROLL TO EXPLORE •

hero.$story: Opens from the 'Watch Our Story' button. Put an .mp4 in /public and set video.src to play it inline; leave it blank and the poster image is shown instead.

story.title: Our Story
body: At Lumière Dental Clinic we combine advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment. Every treatment plan is built around one person: you.
We have treated patients from across Bangalore since 2009, and most of our new appointments still come from someone we have already looked after.

about.title: Personalized Care.
about.body: At Lumière Dental Clinic, we combine advanced technology with a gentle touch to deliver outstanding dental care in a warm, welcoming environment.

portraitImage.alt: Dr. Aanya Mehta, Founder and Chief Dentist

contact.$whatsappMessage: Pre-filled text for every WhatsApp link on the site.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hello Lumière Dental Clinic, I'd like to book an appointment.

address.$geo: Used for the LocalBusiness schema and the 'near me' signal Google reads. Right-click the pin in Google Maps to copy the coordinates.
address.parkingNote: Parking is free behind the building.

$hours: `days` and `time` are what visitors read. `dayOfWeek`, `opens` and `closes` are what Google reads — keep them in sync, and use 24-hour times.

smile.title: Your Best Smile
smile.text: Book your appointment today and experience world class dental care.

ready.title: Ready to Transform
ready.text: Book your appointment today and take the first step toward a healthier, brighter smile.

footer.blurb: We're committed to providing exceptional dental care in a comfortable and caring environment.
footer.$copyright: {year} is replaced with the current year at build time, so this never goes stale.

seo.title: Lumière Dental Clinic | Where Healthy Smiles Begin
seo.description: Advanced dental care in Bangalore — implants, orthodontics, cosmetic dentistry and root canal therapy in a comfortable, hygienic clinic.
seo.$priceRange: Google shows this on the business panel. One to four currency symbols.
seo.$aggregateRating: Only fill this in if the clinic genuinely holds these reviews. Set value to 0 to omit the rating from the structured data entirely.
